report.title: HiredNext Leadership Hiring Pulse — Week of 24 August 2026
report.methodology: Source-linked synthesis of public announcements and reputable reporting combined with HiredNext recruiter interpretation. Not a universal market statistic; no confidential client or candidate information is disclosed.

signals.signal: GCC office leasing in India reportedly rose nearly 38% year-on-year in H1 2026 to about 16.5 million sq ft, with Bengaluru leading.
signals.hirednext_interpretation: Leadership searches should test scale-up ownership and operating-rhythm building, not title equivalence alone.

signals.signal: Economic Times reported that AI skills were powering nearly two-thirds of new GCC hiring in India, citing the foundit Insights Tracker.
signals.hirednext_interpretation: GCC leadership increasingly needs business ownership, engineering fluency and AI-transformation capability.

signals.signal: India's Ministry of Electronics & IT said 12 semiconductor projects had been approved across six states, with India targeting a $200 billion domestic semiconductor market by 2035.
signals.hirednext_interpretation: Talent demand is widening from design into manufacturing, operations, quality, supply chain and cross-functional leadership.

signals.signal: TechnoSport announced a ₹130 crore Erode expansion with 500 jobs, while Karnataka's Tumakuru industrial hub is projected to attract around ₹7,000 crore and create 88,000 jobs.
signals.hirednext_interpretation: Plant and operations leadership searches need location and mobility strategy built into the mandate from the start.

signals.topic: AI changes IT services workforce economics
signals.signal: Reuters reported that major Indian IT services companies are moving toward more outcome-based contracts as AI changes delivery economics.
signals.hirednext_interpretation: Leadership hiring should test productivity transformation, commercial-model change and AI-enabled operating design.
